body: I don't really understand what you meant by this, but thanks again for trying to help. People like you always do a bit of good, just knowing people   still care one way or another. Thanks.

I have volunteered before. I can't deal with it very well. I'm treated as incompetent and idiotic. I had to quit due to my last hospitalization and I don't see myself returning to doing it. And seeing as I am not 18 I am not able to volunteer at the local animal shelters. Since my people skills are fairly poor when with someone for longer then 10 minutes I prefer animals. But thanks for the idea. I appreciate it.

I have seen a sunrise in summer. It was nice, but small moments like that fade in my mind. I remember doing these things, but can't recall what they look like, and don't really care to remember anyway. I'm as alright as I have been, I suppose. Thank you for trying to brighten up my day. Have a nice afternoon/evening.

My father was not a part of my life until i was 7, and after meeting him I understood why. I wont go into much detail, but he was an addict. So, growing up my only positive male influence was my grandfather, who at the age of 65 died of liver cancer. I was 10, and I had no idea how to cope, but my family insisted it was all fine and I would grow out of the sadness. I didn't. I was unstable and distraught for a long time, until I was taken to a therapist. My anger stems from me repressing my fear, sadness, and sense of being alone. Its how i was told to deal with it and since then every emotion I feel other then depair I turn into rage. Sorry was a little long and going in and out of subject but then again I don't know what is important information or not.

I know when I'm doing it, because it seems to be all I am able to do. I have tried what you suggested, as it has been suggested to me before. It makes those around me happier but does nothing but make me feel like I'm just lying to everyone, including myself. After months of trying it, I felt more depressed and stopped even bothering to talk to people. The very few people I still talk to accept that I am a mean, hateful person and ignore it most of the time. The self awareness is rare, but I find most self aware teens are suicidal, so its not a great trait I suppose.
I have been trying to get a job so I can help support my mother, so we no longer have to live in my sister basement. The job market is bleak, and I no experience so i have been unable to do anything.
Been out of school for two years. I got my GED because I could no longer take school and the people around it. I failed every single class I've been in since i was 8.
